1829: BSKII medium (Borrelia)


Final pH: 7.3
Final volume: 100 ml

M 1829
   HEPES                                                              0.51          g
   Trisodium citrate x 2 H2O                                          0.05          g
   Glucose                                                            0.42          g
   Pyruvate                                                           0.06          g
   N-Acetylglucosamine                                                0.03          g
   Sodium bicarbonate                                                 0.18          g
   Yeast extract                                                      0.17          g
   Bacto peptone (Becton Dickinson)                                   0.42          g
   Bovine serum albumin (Fraction V)                                  0.85          g
   Rabbit serum                                                       8.56        ml
   MEM alpha Modification (BioWest Cat No. P0440)                     0.89          g
   Deionized water                                           fill up to 100       ml

Combine all ingredients, adjust pH to 7.3 with 1 M NaOH and filter-sterilize
